title: Matte Gray Freestanding Coat Rack, 60-Inch Solid Brass, Eight Pivoting Pegs, 10X10 Base, Allied Brass
description: Freestanding coat rack with eight pivoting pegs for bathroom organization—ideal for coats, robes, hats, and accessories — available in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials. Floor standing coat rack / freestanding standing coat rack (no wall mount, no wall-mounted installation). Solid brass construction with traditional style and contemporary design elements for traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Size: 60 inches tall (60-inch, 60 in) with a 10 inches x 10 inches footprint (10-inch, 10 in); overall product dimensions (LxHxW) 10 x 60 x 10. Weighted base keeps the rack stable to help prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching on floors. Assembly required. Weight capacity 18 lb. Includes: freestanding coat rack. Lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
